fields.title: One shared core, thin provider-specific packages
fields.statement: Concentrate the framework's logic in a shared core and expose it through thin, provider-specific packages (ArgentSea.Sql for SQL Server, ArgentSea.Pg for PostgreSQL). Support each provider fully on its own terms and keep dependencies minimal; a single model class targets exactly one provider, not several at once.
fields.rationale: Most behavior is provider-agnostic and belongs in one place; only the ADO.NET-specific bindings (SqlClient, Npgsql) differ, which is why the two packages both install a shared core and split into `ArgentSea` versus `ArgentSea.Sql`/`ArgentSea.Pg` namespaces. Mixing providers within one model would force the Mapper to guess which provider will execute its parameters and would multiply the per-provider delegate machinery — complexity that a review found exceeds its value. Separate projects or microservices are the clean answer when an application must reach multiple providers.

metadata.provenanceNote: Derived from ArgentSea.DocFx during initial agentic onboarding, 2026-07-19. Draft for operator review.
